propositions: Serena write_memory tool requires explicit approval_mode configuration in .codex/config.toml to function in the Codex project.
The mcp_servers.serena.tools.write_memory table must define approval_mode with value "approve" per MCP configuration schema.
Codex --strict-config validation must accept the project configuration and reject unknown configuration keys.
Existing Serena server fields (command, args, startup_timeout_sec, enabled) must remain unchanged when adding the write_memory tool approval configuration.
